template.replacement_policy: installed renderer supplies validated token, exact source92 manifest hash and slash-normalized owned absolute world path; no project engine-code strings
template.line_convention: one-based UTF-8 text lines; substitutions add no newline; rendered-to-template line identity retained separately from production Beryl maps

source_identity.source_sha256: caller-pinned exact 92-file manifest, excludes this future RPC
source_identity.token: caller-pinned source92, template, transport, checker, engine and tool identities
source_identity.prior_inputs: all original 92 files remain byte-for-byte unchanged; this handler is the sole added source

proven_loader_source.scope: source-linked generic fixture mechanism; does not establish this handler's compilation or tablet delivery

native_resources.registration: native world alias and registered GUID must independently roundtrip to the exact frozen absolute world; prefab must resolve as a valid native entity source
native_resources.spawn_world: fresh nonnull GetGame().GetWorld() in verified play mode; each returned owner must be in that world

phase_policy.0: one-shot module/world setup; ready only from exact native world/mode observations
phase_policy.2: two native-created owners; pending even when frames_ready is true
phase_policy.3: one edit-mode request with scalar prefix retained; pending until real edit/noGame/noPlay
phase_policy.4: complete only after final bounded scalar trace and prefix/cap/reset checks in the same owned edit world

checksum.input: exact ASCII pipe-delimited row bytes and one newline per row

trace.numeric_scope: rounded finite native float.ToString observations only; no exact binary32 encoding claim
trace.pending_arrays: rows and caseIds remain empty; row_count/checksum zero; frame_counts empty before two registered owners, then exactly two counts
trace.independent_admission: scripts/verify-tablet-native-trace.py validates complete raw rows; engine scan and emitted case names alone do not establish semantic verification

retention.existing_observer: at most two retained owner/State references and 1024 plain observation records
retention.handler: at most one 1024-row scalar string prefix, one bounded scan and one bounded response at a time; no strong entity references added across requests
retention.after_play: no retained owner or State dereference; only plain observation fields and registry array counts are inspected
retention.handoff: include frames delivered during stop; reject later failure, exhausted budget, missing rows, changed prefix or registry reset; no early snapshot may suppress failure

primary_declarations.scope: GetModule/OpenModule, native resource-name and absolute-path resolution
SetOpenedResource request signature; its return is not load completion
GetApi and switch requests; void returns do not establish mode completion
GetWorld/InPlayMode/SpawnEntityPrefab declarations; native spawn target is Game world
OnPostInit/EOnFrame/GetEventMask declarations used by unchanged observer
Length/ToAscii used by source-linked bounded checksum
thread/Sleep declaration examples; exactly one fixed worker yield

origins.operation: trusted typed response declaration and RegV field mapping
zero-based exact raw scalar row encoding
bounded checksum over retained raw bytes
engine prerequisite scalar scan; full admission remains independent
post-play prefix/cap/reset checks and complete receipt publication
typed installed action boundary and native identity gates
two native prefab spawns in verified Game world
one native edit-mode request; later status proves completion

required_transport.ownership: fresh hidden process, exact executable hash/PID/start identity, owned mutex/listener; no reuse or unrelated stop
required_transport.source_checks: exact93 input manifest and pinned tools/adapter/engine around every returned RPC
required_transport.logs: untouched raw RPC responses and raw logs retained after confirmed owned exit; derive codec separately
required_transport.fallback: forbidden; no request resubmission, alternate opener or deadline widening

evidence_state.source_checks: reported separately by immutable pure-source receipt; not a runtime assertion
